title: The Summer Queen
html:
The Summer Queen is a named Summer Queen seen at level 52.

Where to find The Summer Queen

  • in the wilds around 2249, 1476

What it can drop

  • Summer Scepter (unique Shagbark Staff, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). 10% of damage spells stun the primary target for 1 second. Counts as a 9 carat staff enchant for spells of every school. The stun lasts half as long on players.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
